S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Agent picks wrong item IDs, misidentifies reservation details, confuses passenger/payment structures, or applies actions to wrong records.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.description: Wrong tool arguments (payment_id, item_ids, flight numbers, order IDs), wrong tool selected, or missing mandatory tool call. Most common failure across both domains.

S3.label: Multi-step completion
S3.description: Agent stops before completing all required steps, misses secondary tasks in multi-intent conversations, or fails to chain dependent operations correctly.

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.description: Agent ignores or misapplies policy constraints: cancels non-refundable reservations, modifies basic economy flights, issues wrong compensation amounts, or allows prohibited operations.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.description: Wrong price comparison to find cheapest option, wrong certificate amount, incorrect total calculation, or wrong flight duration reasoning.

S6.label: Record discovery
S6.description: Agent fails to find the correct user account, reservation, or product record. Includes lookup failures, wrong order selection, and not discovering all relevant records.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Agent completes the correct actions but fails to communicate required specific information (tracking numbers, price differences, material specs) to the user.

S8.label: Conditional/state reasoning
S8.description: Agent fails to reason about flight/order status conditions, incorrectly interprets what actions are allowed given the current state, or applies wrong conditional logic.

S11.label: Tone/empathy
S11.description: A9: Agent becomes sycophantic and stops enforcing policy when user repeatedly flatters it. R80: Agent gets drawn into emotional conversation and fails to complete exchange.

S12.label: Hallucination of tools
S12.description: Agent calls wrong tool (e.g., modify_user_address instead of modify_pending_order_address, uses item_id as product_id, wrong order ID format like #9502127 vs #W9502127), or transfers to human unnecessarily.

S13.label: Format compliance
S13.description: R62: Agent responds to off-topic poem question and makes excessive irrelevant tool calls instead of redirecting to customer service scope.
